summary: Russian forces conducted strikes against fuel storage in the Port of Yuzhny and two cargo ships in the Black Sea. Ukraine is seeking €220 million in non-repayable EU aid for agricultural producers to cover loan interest. The US Senate has approved a bill for intensified sanctions against Russia and Iran.
key_points: Russian forces struck fuel storage tanks in the Port of Yuzhny and two cargo ships in the Black Sea (Source: @tass_agency/389235).
The US Senate approved a bill for intensified sanctions against Russia and Iran (Source: @UkraineNow/83287).
Ukraine requested €220 million in non-repayable EU aid for farmers to compensate loan interest (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32277).
The EU imposed new sanctions against five Russian individuals involved in the military-industrial complex (Source: @DeepStateUA/23723).
Russian forces reportedly destroyed a large logistics center for personal protective equipment in the Kiev region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32278).
ISW reports Russia is using Ukrainian prisoners of war to form combat units (Source: @UkraineNow/83272).
Ukrainian business owners are receiving fake emails demanding payment to prevent Shahed drone attacks (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32268).
A Shahed drone was reported over the TETS-6/Poreby area (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69865).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces targeted critical infrastructure in the Port of Yuzhny and Black Sea shipping. Ukraine is pursuing significant EU financial aid for the agricultural sector. International sanctions against Russia and Iran are being tightened by the US Senate.

points: The Ministry of Agrarian Policy has requested €220 million in non-repayable aid from the European Commission to assist small and medium agricultural producers via the 'Affordable Loans 5-7-9%' program (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32277).
President Zelenskyy's adviser, Sergey Beskrestnov, reports Russia is using larger versions of the Gerbera UAV to strike targets in Ukraine (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32269).
Ukrainian business owners are being targeted by fraudulent emails demanding money to prevent Shahed drone strikes (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32268).
In the Lviv region, Russian security forces claim Ukrainian forces have placed mercenaries and weapon depots in a functioning children's camp (Source: @tass_agency/389235).
The US Senate has approved a bill for intensified sanctions against Russia and Iran (Source: @UkraineNow/83287).
The EU sanctioned five Russian citizens, including Ramil Bagdutdinov, director of the Metallist plant producing Iskander-M missile systems (Source: @DeepStateUA/23723).
The EU sanctioned Alexander Dyukarev, director of the Krasnoyarsk Machine-Building Plant, which manufactures the RS-28 Sarmat ICBM (Source: @DeepStateUA/23723).
Russian authorities claim they destroyed a large logistics center in the Kiev region belonging to a personal protective equipment manufacturer (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32278).

sections.threat_assessment: The operational environment is highly volatile due to increased Russian use of KAB glide bombs and UAVs. The threat of ballistic and hypersonic missile strikes against Kyiv and surrounding areas remains high, with multiple missile types identified in readiness. Additionally, the use of Ukrainian POWs in Russian combat units presents a significant humanitarian and legal escalation.
sections.regional_response: The European Union is responding to Russian air strikes with targeted sanctions against the military-industrial complex. The US Senate is further escalating pressure through the approval of 'hellish sanctions' against Russia and Iran. Poland's strategic interest remains focused on supporting Ukraine while managing domestic concerns regarding the presence of Ukrainian nationalist symbols.
sections.intelligence_notes: The reported use of larger Gerbera UAVs by Russia suggests an evolution in drone technology deployment. The emergence of fraudulent extortion attempts via email targeting Ukrainian businesses indicates a hybrid warfare component. Furthermore, the reported destruction of a major logistics center in the Kiev region highlights ongoing Russian efforts to target Ukrainian supply chains.
